watches.summary: DM opens festival preparations in the morning; the move to the practice spot takes a few minutes.
Preparations finish close to sunset; the procession begins toward the Great Temple.
The opening rite follows the near-sunset procession and was scheduled for sunset.
DM calls the dinner frame evening and nighttime; Heska fishes before the companions assemble.

The evening palm scene resumes; heightened abilities disappear after approximately two minutes.
